description:
Reborn as a side character in a novel, Marin swears she’ll avoid every major figure in the story. But when her family collapses overnight, she finds herself cast out onto the streets with nothing.

*" I need money—fast."*

Forced by circumstance, she accepts a six-month temporary position at the estate of the novel’s blind male lead, Duke Gerald.

*“How is life in the duke’s manor?”

“Thanks to Your Grace’s generosity, I’m living quite comfortably.”

“You like living here? Then we should get engaged.”*

Marin freezes. How does enjoying life in the manor suddenly connect to an engagement?

*“Congratulations. Now you can keep living in the place you like.”

“By any chance… do I have the right to refuse?”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
